entries.text: Zean made the first leaf bed.
Lair pinned the first notice to the board.
Rex filled the first request on the board: more stick.
Chob built the first drying rack.
Bral was born to Rex and Ket.
Chool was born to Ne and Lair.
Zean worked a hide until it stayed soft. They watched it happen.
The Hide age begins.
Zean brought down the first hopper: fresh meat.
The village can now raise a hide teepee (hide stretched on poles): the design is in the Blueprints panel.
Zean saw that a hopper will stay where it is fed, and understood. They worked it out with their own hands.
Cheak was born to Chob and Zean.
Zean saw a seed come up where food had rotted, and understood. They watched it happen.
The old thornback died in its cave.
A new thornback has moved into the cave.
Rex is known for singing: sings to the others at rest.
Ket is known for singing: sings to the others at rest.
Ne is known for weaving grass: plaits grass into small trinkets.
Lair is known for collecting stones: keeps a hoard of fine pebbles.
Chob is known for singing: sings to the others at rest.
Lightning struck a tree 13 cells from the camp. It is burning.
Bral was first to keep a fire. They watched it happen.
The Hearth age dawns, behind the Hide age.
Ne had only seen it done, and now knows firecraft.
Rex built the first fire ring.
Chob lit the first hearth fire.
The burning tree has fallen in on itself and smoulders.
Ne was first to burn wood to black coal. They watched it happen.
The old thornback died in its cave.
Bal is known for stargazing: knows the stars by name.
Zean is known for carving: carves small figures from wood.
A new thornback has moved into the cave.
Di was born to Ne and Lair.
The old thornback died in its cave.
A new thornback has moved into the cave.
The first winter is over: 11 survive.
A whole winter passed and nobody died of cold.

curio.text: Old worked stones, half buried in the ground. Somebody made these, and they are gone.
